description: Reference-checked removal of one UNREFERENCED uploaded asset (refused while any published version pins it, the current draft references it, or its reservation is in flight). Safe replacement is upload-new → revision-fenced draft swap → validate → remove old once removable; bytes are NEVER overwritten behind an existing asset id. Requires confirmRemove=true, an idempotency key, and lms:write.

idempotencyKey.description: Required request idempotency key. Reuse it only for the identical operation.

name: opentrain_lms_manage_asset
